titulo: Justin Bieber performs surprise acoustic gig in beleaguered Los Angeles park
cuerpo: Small crowd enjoys singer’s free concert in MacArthur Park, which has often drawn headlines for less cheery reasons With no announcement and little fanfare, Justin Bieber performed a free acoustic set on Monday at a Los Angeles park often in local headlines for less cheery reasons. In videos that surfaced online, four musicians flanked the global phenom, who wore a plain T-shirt and shorts as he sang hits including Daisies and Yukon. The low-key affair with a small crowd stood in stark contrast to Bieber’s recent blockbuster World Cup and Coachella performances. Continue reading...
